review_candidates.title: Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: The Role We're seeking a Systems Administrator to architect, deploy, secure, and maintain the core systems powering our organization — spanning both corporate IT and the operational technology (OT) behind our deployed microgrids. This dual role blends hands-on engineering with day-to-day administration, with heavy emphasis on access/permissions management, security hardening and compliance (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2), network administration, remote connectivity, and monitoring across IT and field OT assets. Strong networking fundamentals are required; hands-on OT/ICS experience in energy, utilities, or renewables is strongly preferred. This hybrid role will report to our Sr Manager, IT and be based in our HQ in Ridgewood, NJ. Key responsibilities will include: Systems Engineering: Design, deploy, and maintain server, storage, and virtualized infrastructure (cloud and on-prem), including Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory/Azure AD, and automation/IaC practices Administration: Own identity and access management end-to-end (onboarding/offboarding, role-based permissions, MFA, privileged access, backups, audit logging); apply patches/updates and maintain system health and availability Security & Compliance: Serve as primary owner of access governance and least-privilege design; administer EDR, SIEM, MDM, and vulnerability management tools; extend controls into OT (segmentation, secure remote access); support SOC 2/ISO 27001 audit readiness and incident response Troubleshooting & Support: Provide Tier 1–3 support across Windows, macOS, Linux, virtualization, and cloud; engage vendors as needed Cloud Administration: Manage Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Azure (VMs, storage, identity, conditional access); implement cloud backup/DR Network & Connectivity: Design and maintain switching, routing, VLANs, firewalls, and VPNs; configure cellular modems/gateways for microgrid site connectivity (carrier/APN/SIM provisioning, NAT, failover); build secure IT/OT remote access paths OT & Field Systems: Support microgrid controllers, PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, inverters, and meters; troubleshoot protocol-level issues (Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, SNMP, BACnet); partner with Scale’s control team for on-site commissioning and OT patch/firmware management Monitoring & Observability: Build and tune monitoring/alerting across IT and OT (health, connectivity, data flow, backups, security events); create dashboards and reduce MTTD/MTTR Documentation: Maintain system/network diagrams, SOPs, configuration baselines, and runbooks; generate performance and capacity reports The Ideal Candidate Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience); 5+ years as a Systems Engineer/Administrator with direct network administration responsibility OT/ICS/SCADA experience in energy, utilities, renewables, or industrial/building systems strongly preferred Demonstrated experience with NIST, ISO 27001, and/or SOC 2 frameworks Certifications preferred: Network+/Security+, CCNA, Azure Administrator, MCSA/MCSE, RHCSA, GICSP, or similar Technical Proficiency: Windows Server, Linux (Ubuntu/CentOS), Active Directory, Azure AD, Group Policy, M365; VMware/Hyper-V Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, VLANs, DNS/DHCP, NAT, firewalls, VPNs Hands-on experience with cellular modems/industrial gateways (Cradlepoint, Sierra Wireless, Digi, Teltonika, Peplink) and carrier/SIM management Monitoring/alerting tools (PRTG, SolarWinds, Datadog, Zabbix, Grafana); backup/DR platforms (Veeam, Datto) Familiarity with industrial protocols and IT/OT segmentation; Zero Trust and NIST 800-82/IEC 62443 knowledge a plus Strong analytical and communication skills; highly organized and detail-oriented; collaborative, customer-focused mindset Willingness to travel to office, project, and client sites, including field visits to operating microgrid sites. Approximate travel 25% Ability to participate in an on-call rotation and evening/nighttime system migration tasks when required This is a great opportunity to have a long-term impact on a fast-paced, private equity-backed growth business. Some of the core virtues embraced by Scales’ employees include: Do the Right Thing Act Like an Owner Hustle Demand Results Go Together Evolve or Disappear We offer a competitive compensation package and a comprehensive benefits program including medical benefits, paid vacation and holidays, and 401K matching. About Scale Microgrids Scale is redefining resilience, with advanced microgrids that go beyond traditional backup power solutions to give businesses the power to adapt and thrive amid all of today’s growing energy challenges. As a vertically-integrated provider of turnkey advanced microgrid systems, Scale combines project design, engineering, and execution expertise with microgrid-as-a-service financing to offer our customers systems that are optimized to deliver maximum value from day one while ensuring ultra-reliable operations and fast time-to-power. Scale is backed by EQT, a firm with :$250B in assets, bringing a depth of experience, resources, and capital that will enable Scale to continue pursuing our vision of powering the world with distributed energy. The investment enables Scale to own and operate billions of dollars in distributed generation assets. To learn more about Scale Microgrids, please visit https://www.scalemicrogrids.com. About EQT EQT is a leading purpose-driven global investment organization with EUR 246 billion in total assets under management, divided into two business segments: Private Capital and Real Assets. EQT owns portfolio companies and assets in Europe, Asia Pacific, and the Americas and supports them in achieving sustainable growth, operational excellence, and market leadership. To learn more about EQT, please visit https://eqtgroup.com. Scale strives to attract and retain a workforce that reflects the composition of our customer base and communities. We are committed to providing a work environment that provides everyone with equal access and opportunity to contribute and drive meaningful outcomes. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.title: System Engineer – Data Center & Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: IT Centric è un System Integrator innovativo che opera nelle aree dell’Information Technology, delle Telecomunicazioni e dell’Ingegneria dei Sistemi. Attraverso un team di specialisti con competenze trasversali, supportiamo i nostri clienti nella generazione di valore dai servizi IT e nell’evoluzione dei processi tecnologici. Per il potenziamento della nostra area Infrastructure & Data Center, siamo alla ricerca di un System Engineer con una buona visione d'insieme del Data Center e competenze trasversali in ambito Networking. Profilo Ideale Cerchiamo un professionista che abbia già maturato un'esperienza sistemistica e che desideri evolvere verso un ruolo sempre più orientato alla progettazione e alla gestione di infrastrutture enterprise. Il candidato ideale comprende le interazioni tra sistemi, storage, networking e sicurezza ed è in grado di affrontare attività di delivery e troubleshooting con un approccio metodico e orientato alla qualità del servizio. Esperienza Richiesta Cerchiamo candidati con 3 – 5 anni di esperienza maturati in almeno uno dei seguenti contesti: System Integrator Managed Service Provider (MSP) NOC Data Center Reparti IT Enterprise È richiesta una comprovata esperienza nella gestione di infrastrutture mission-critical, server farm, ambienti di virtualizzazione, networking, soluzioni di backup e storage. Principali Responsabilità Infrastruttura e Virtualizzazione: Installazione e configurazione di server fisici e virtuali; gestione di ambienti VMware vSphere, Nutanix e MS Hyper-V. Sistemi e Servizi di Rete: Gestione di sistemi Microsoft Windows Server, installazione e amministrazione di Active Directory, gestione di DNS, DHCP e GPO. Troubleshooting e Maintenance: Attività di troubleshooting sistemistico di II e III livello; gestione del Patch Management e implementazione delle policy di Hardening per sistemi Windows. Storage e Data Protection: Gestione e manutenzione di SAN/Storage Enterprise e delle soluzioni di Backup Enterprise. Operations e Documentazione: Monitoraggio proattivo delle infrastrutture, redazione della documentazione tecnica e supporto ai Project Manager durante le fasi progettuali. Competenze Tecniche Richieste Sistemi Operativi: Windows Server (versioni 2016 / 2019 / 2022 / 2025) Active Directory e servizi essenziali (DNS, DHCP) Conoscenze base/intermedie di ambienti Linux Virtualizzazione: VMware vSphere, Nutanix. Storage: Conoscenza di architetture SAN Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NAS, configurazioni RAID e Multipath. Backup: Esperienza con almeno una delle principali soluzioni di Backup Enterprise (es. Veeam, Commvault, Rubrik, ecc.). Networking & Security: Buona conoscenza di TCP/IP, VLAN, Trunk, Spanning Tree, Routing statico, OSPF (base), ACL, NAT, VPN Site-to-Site e concetti di Firewalling. Gradita esperienza operativa su switch Layer 2 e Layer 3. Cloud: Conoscenza ed operatività sistemistica su ambienti Cloud. Nice to Have / Certificazioni Preferenziali Saranno considerati elementi preferenziali il possesso di certificazioni o competenze avanzate in: Microsoft: Hyper-V, Azure, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Exchange, Intune. Virtualizzazione & OS: Certificazioni Nutanix, VMware, Linux (Ubuntu, RedHat, SUSE). Storage Enterprise: Dell EMC, NetApp, Pure Storage. Sicurezza: Microsoft Defender, Hardening baseline (es. CIS Benchmark). Cosa Offriamo Retribuzione Annuale Lorda (RAL): € 30.000 - € 40.000, commisurata all'effettiva esperienza maturata e alle competenze rilevate in sede di colloquio. Crescita Professionale: Opportunità di lavorare su progetti innovativi e architetture enterprise complesse, con accesso a percorsi di formazione continua e certificazioni ufficiali. Ambiente Stimolante: Un contesto dinamico e altamente qualificato che incentiva l'autonomia e il lavoro di squadra. Sede di Lavoro Roma – Modalità ibrida (in presenza / remote working secondo le policy aziendali). Unisciti a noi! Se sei una persona ambiziosa e vuoi far parte di un'azienda in rapida crescita che crede nel valore dell'innovazione, inviaci il tuo CV con l'autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali secondo il D. Lgs. 196/03 e il GDPR 679/16. IT Centric valorizza la diversità e accoglie candidature da persone di ogni età, genere e nazionalità, in conformità alle leggi 903/77 e 125/91 e ai decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03.

review_candidates.title: Senior IT Infrastructure and Systems Engineer - Network
review_candidates.description: IT Infrastructure and Systems Engineer – Network Join our fast-growing Corporate IT team and play a key role in shaping the backbone of Flat Rock’s global technology environment. As an IT Infrastructure and Systems Engineer, you’ll design, build, and manage critical infrastructure that powers our operations worldwide. From data centers and cloud platforms to collaboration tools and secure networks, you’ll help us scale with resilience, efficiency, and innovation. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where your expertise will directly enable business growth, global expansion, and the delivery of cutting-edge solutions.   What You’ll Do In this role, you will: Design, build, and support enterprise networks, servers, storage, telephony, and systems. Engineer secure, fault-tolerant, and scalable solutions across on-premise, co-location, and cloud environments. Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and architectural guidance across IT and business teams. Act as a trusted escalation point for complex technical issues. Lead infrastructure and application projects, from system migrations to global rollouts. Drive the migration of legacy systems to modern cloud-first solutions (AWS, Azure). Partner with vendors and managed service providers to ensure seamless service delivery. Contribute to the enterprise-wide strategy for infrastructure, systems, and international expansion. Define and implement disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.   What You Bring Personal Qualities A self-sufficient, motivated professional who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Service-oriented with a customer-first mindset. Strong communicator who can translate technical detail into business value. Flexible, with the ability to adapt to after-hours project work. Experienced in working within global 24x7 operations and regulated environments (SOX). A natural mentor, eager to guide less experienced team members. Bonus: background in healthcare, life sciences, pharma, or biotech. Technical Expertise 8+ years of hands-on engineering experience with enterprise networks, servers, and storage systems. Proven expertise with VMware (ESXi, vSphere, vCenter). Strong skills in firewalls, switches, wireless infrastructure (physical and virtual). Deep knowledge of Microsoft Server OS & Active Directory. Solid experience with cloud computing and storage (AWS and Azure). Experience delivering disaster recovery and business continuity solutions. Proficiency with Microsoft 365 collaboration suite (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online). Scripting skills to automate and optimize infrastructure management. Familiarity with patch management, monitoring tools, and ITIL frameworks. Linux knowledge is a plus.   Education & Certifications Degree in Information Systems or a related field (AA minimum) – or equivalent hands-on experience. Certifications preferred: Cisco (CCNA/CCNP) Microsoft O365 Windows Server Networking certifications   Why Join Us? At Flat Rock, you’ll do more than maintain IT systems - you’ll help build the digital foundation of a company driving innovation and global growth. This is your opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies, lead meaningful projects, and grow your career alongside a passionate, forward-thinking team.

review_candidates.title: Network Infrastructure Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Network Infrastructure Specialist Job Category: Information Technology Time Type: Full time Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret Employee Type: Regular Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% Type of Travel: Local * * * The Opportunity Join a team responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining the enterprise network infrastructure that enables mission-critical operations across a global technology environment. As a Network Infrastructure Specialist, you will support the planning, deployment, operation, and modernization of highly available network solutions that connect users, applications, and systems around the world. This requisition supports multiple experience levels—from technicians and administrators responsible for day-to-day network operations to engineers and architects designing enterprise routing, switching, firewall, wireless, and cloud networking solutions. Successful candidates will collaborate across infrastructure, cybersecurity, systems engineering, and operations teams to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable network services supporting domestic and international missions. If you enjoy solving complex connectivity challenges, implementing modern networking technologies, and building secure enterprise infrastructure, you'll find meaningful opportunities to grow your career while supporting a global mission. Opportunities are contingent upon contract award Responsibilities Depending on experience and level, responsibilities may include: Install, configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless networks, and related technologies. Support the design, implementation, and optimization of local area networks (LAN), wide area networks (WAN), wireless networks, and software-defined networking solutions. Configure and maintain network routing, switching, VPN connectivity, network segmentation, quality of service (QoS), and high-availability solutions. Deploy, administer, and optimize enterprise firewall technologies, intrusion prevention systems, and network security controls. Monitor network performance, availability, capacity, and reliability while identifying and resolving connectivity issues. Perform network upgrades, technology refreshes, equipment installations, firmware updates, and lifecycle replacement activities. Develop and maintain network diagrams, configuration documentation, technical standards, and operational procedures. Conduct network performance analysis, capacity planning, and trend analysis to improve enterprise reliability and scalability. Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to implement secure network architectures, Zero Trust principles, access controls, and compliance requirements. Support cloud networking, hybrid infrastructure, remote connectivity, and enterprise modernization initiatives. Develop automation solutions to streamline network provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, and operational support. Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, disaster recovery planning, and continuity of operations activities. Evaluate emerging networking technologies and recommend solutions that improve performance, resiliency, and operational efficiency. Senior-level professionals may develop enterprise network architecture, establish engineering standards, lead modernization initiatives, mentor technical staff, and provide strategic guidance across multiple programs. Required Qualifications Qualifications vary based on position level. High School diploma with relevant experience or bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Network Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Active Secret Clearance Experience supporting enterprise network administration, engineering, implementation, or operations. Knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching, network protocols, and enterprise connectivity principles. Experience installing, configuring, maintaining, or troubleshooting enterprise networking equipment. Familiarity with network monitoring, performance analysis, troubleshooting methodologies, and technical documentation. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to obtain and maintain any required Government security clearance. Desired Qualifications Experience supporting enterprise networking platforms including Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, or similar technologies. Experience configuring routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, multicast, and VPN technologies. Experience with enterprise firewall administration, network segmentation, IDS/IPS, secure remote access, and Zero Trust networking. Experience supporting LAN, WAN, wireless, SD-WAN, software-defined networking (SDN), and cloud networking environments. Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, AWS, hybrid cloud networking, and virtual networking technologies. Experience with network automation using Python, Ansible, REST APIs, PowerShell, or Infrastructure as Code methodologies. Experience using enterprise network monitoring and management platforms such as SolarWinds, Cisco DNA Center, ThousandEyes, PRTG, or similar tools. Experience supporting Federal Government or Department of State enterprise IT environments. Knowledge of ITIL service management, change management, and configuration management practices. Relevant certifications such as Cisco CCNA, CCNP, CCIE, Juniper JNCIA/JNCIP, Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE, Fortinet NSE, CompTIA Network+, Security+, or ITIL Foundation. This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI. What You Can Expect A culture of integrity. At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation. An environment of trust. CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality. A focus on continuous growth. Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy. Pay Range There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits. The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is $103,800 - $218,100 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

review_candidates.title: System Administrator
review_candidates.description: JOB SUMMARY Specialty Systems, Inc. has an opening for a Systems and Network Administrator with the skills and experience described below to join our team of technical professionals supporting our Department of Defense customer at Joint Base MDL. In this position, you will have a high-profile role in the development and qualification of systems used to support unique Department of Defense missions. Ideal candidates will have a broad set of technical skills and must be able to work both independently and within a team environment. As a member of our team, you will play a key role in ensuring that systems with a direct impact on our country's warfighting and peacekeeping capabilities perform at optimal levels. The Systems and Network Administrator provides support to U.S. Navy programs by administering and maintaining mixed Windows and Linux server environments and the supporting local network infrastructure used by mission-critical development, test, and operational systems. This is a hands-on infrastructure role in a laboratory environment rather than a full-scale Network Operations Center. The position is responsible for server and virtualization administration, basic managed-switch and endpoint configuration, network documentation, connectivity troubleshooting, and system security in compliance with DoD cybersecurity policies and Navy operational requirements. This position is located at our customer site at Joint Base MDL. You will work our customer's Compressed Work Schedule, which consists of four 9-hour days (Monday-Thursday) and one 8-hour day (Friday) during the first week of the cycle, followed by four 9-hour days (Monday-Thursday) and Friday off during the second week. This results in a three-day weekend every other week! RESPONSIBILITIES Install, configure, secure, and maintain Windows Server and Linux operating systems in development, integration, test, and production environments. Administer user accounts, permissions, directory services, and Group Policy in accordance with approved access-control and cybersecurity requirements. Monitor system health and resource utilization; perform performance tuning and troubleshoot hardware, operating system, application-hosting, and availability issues. Manage server and network-device patching, updates, vulnerability remediation, configuration backups, and lifecycle maintenance. Administer and support virtualized environments such as VMware, Hyper-V, or comparable platforms. Install and configure managed network switches, including access ports, VLAN assignments, port security, firmware, and saved configurations, within approved network designs. Configure servers, workstations, test equipment, and other endpoints for network connectivity, including network interfaces, IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, and approved security settings. Troubleshoot physical and logical connectivity issues involving cabling, switch ports, VLANs, addressing, name resolution, and routing; document findings and coordinate escalation when required. Support physical network infrastructure, including racks, cabling, labeling, and connection management for laboratory and test environments. Maintain system and network documentation, architecture diagrams, IP address plans, port maps, asset records, and configuration baselines. Support the integration of systems and endpoints into secure Navy networks and enclaves in coordination with network, cybersecurity, and infrastructure stakeholders. Collaborate with developers, cybersecurity personnel, system administrators, and engineers to support application hosting, laboratory operations, accreditation activities, and incident resolution. review_candidates.title: Senior Network Security Engineer, Operational Technology
review_candidates.description: CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com. What You’ll Do CoreWeave’s Network Security team ensures network infrastructure is secure, resilient and compliant. Our team partners with engineering, product teams, and partners to build secure network solutions that protect critical infrastructure and continuously improve the security posture to meet the needs of our customers. With our growing reliance on connected technology, the need to keep critical systems secure, reliable, and resilient has never been more important. We are seeking an OT Security Engineer to join our team and play a pivotal role in safeguarding the operational technologies that support our datacenter networks. About The Role This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the crossroads of cyber security, operational technology (OT), engineering, and datacenter operations. As the network security engineer responsible for our operational technology networks, your responsibilities will include identifying and evaluating cybersecurity risks, designing and launching pragmatic security solutions, and embedding security controls directly into the operational systems and technologies supporting our infrastructure. You will work with suppliers and third parties in benchmarking their capabilities against expectations and industry standards. You will also lead efforts in partnering with peer security teams and partners in production engineering as you lead continuous improvement of security posture for operational technology network environments and the devices connected. This role requires both depth in understanding network security, and breadth of knowledge of the unique challenges that face the industry in securing the infrastructure that is the foundation of modern datacenters. You will act as a trusted partner who goes beyond advisory work to roll up your sleeves and deliver. Some Things You Will Work On Establishing standards for security expectations covering all operational technology networks and devices connected to them. This will include network segmentation, host isolation, network traversal controls, and remote connectivity. Providing solutions to complex security issues, manage multiple tasks, and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment. Creating an inventory and risk register that can be used as a baseline in understanding near term and long term objectives. Partnering with production engineering and business development teams evaluating priorities for risk reduction in current deployments, and risk avoidance by evolving standards for future growth. Executing and partnering with other parties in using penetration testing to evaluate effectiveness of existing controls. Coordinating with third parties and internal teams in addressing vulnerabilities via mitigation, isolation or other strategies to protect critical infrastructure in these environments. Researching industry risks and drive change in operational networks to continuously reduce risk Developing and test recovery models and response playbooks to handle compromise scenarios. Presenting technical security information to both technical and non-technical audiences, including external partners. Maintain technical documentation, reports, and security tooling with attention to detail. Who You Are 5+ Years of experience in network infrastructure security (firewalls, ACLs, architecture, risk management) in a global network environment. Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Go, Python, C/C++) for automation, code reviews, and tooling. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCNP, PCNSE are advantageous. Experience with operational technology networks (factory or industrial systems, building management systems, power, physical security systems, remote access, HVAC, etc.), factory networks or other similar environments. Strong technical knowledge of network firewalls, virtual private networks, network segmentation, and defense in depth. Able to navigate ambiguity, identify root causes, and solve complex security problems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong technical documentation abilities. Capable of working independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong desire to continuously learn and adopt new technologies and security techniques. Preferred Prior experience with operational technology networks that span global locations Experience with the range of obscure solutions that are often deployed on operational technology networks. Deep understanding of business-wide security best practices and implementation strategies. Experience with network automation, agentic network tooling, and incident response automation. Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk. You love to solve problems that few others would tackle. You’re curious about critical network infrastructure that is the foundation of modern data centers. You’re an expert in network security with a passion to explore the more exotic nature of operational technology. Why CoreWeave? About At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values: Be Curious at Your Core Act Like an Owner Empower Employees Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences Achieve More Together We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us! The base salary range for this role is $164,000 to $242,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility). What We Offer The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave Company-paid Life Insurance Voluntary supplemental life insurance Short and long-term disability insurance Flexible Spending Account Health Savings Account Tuition Reimbursement Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health Family-Forming support provided by Carrot Paid Parental Leave Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside 401(k) with a generous employer match Flexible PTO Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations A casual work environment A work culture focused on innovative disruption California Applicants California Consumer Privacy Act Equal Opportunity & Accommodations CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) , CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com. Export Control Compliance This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. Assists in the implementation of operational projects linked to strategic goals and priorities of the Foundation. Participates in community planning efforts, workshops and conferences. Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Information Systems or related field required. Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. Four (4) or more years of progressive IT experience, including systems administration, end-user support and IT operations required. Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and endpoint management platforms (Intune or comparable) required. Experience supporting event, board meeting or conference technology (e.g., AV, hybrid meetings, live streaming) strongly preferred. Experience working in a nonprofit, foundation or financial-services-adjacent environment preferred. Working knowledge of PowerShell or scripting for administration and automation preferred. A flexible schedule is required (may support events, meetings or incidents outside normal business hours). Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Ability to support the mission, vision and values of the Greater Milwaukee Foundation and abide by applicable standards of conduct, policies, and procedures. Demonstrated commitment to racial equity and inclusion. Self-motivated and able to work independently, take initiative and solve problems. Demonstrated superior customer service skills and aptitude; ability to interact effectively with people from diverse backgrounds. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite applications, web-based applications, and databases. Must be honest, dependable, and able to handle multiple tasks while being organized and meeting deadlines. Ability to communicate respectfully and effectively, verbally and in writing. Demonstrated aptitude for financial analysis.  Knowledge of different accounting systems/financial policies/business environments.  Ability to learn new procedures quickly and accurately. Certifications, Licenses, Registrations One or more of the following preferred: CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft 365 Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate (MD-102), Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or ITIL Foundation. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Position Summary The Senior Storage Engineer (L3) – Backup, Recovery & Data Protection Engineering is responsible for the design, engineering, implementation, operation, and continuous optimization of enterprise backup, recovery, cyber resilience, and data protection solutions supporting Humana's mission-critical business services and healthcare platforms. This position serves as a senior technical leader within the Storage Engineering organization and functions as a primary escalation point for complex backup, recovery, and data protection challenges. The engineer will drive the strategy, architecture, and operational excellence of enterprise data protection platforms while ensuring recoverability, compliance, security, and resiliency across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure environments. The role is responsible for engineering and supporting enterprise-scale solutions leveraging IBM Storage Protect, IBM Storage Defender Data Protect, IBM Storage Protect (Spectrum Protect/TSM), Rubrik, Commvault and related technologies. The engineer will play a key role in data protect engeineering, cyber recovery initiatives, ransomware resilience, platform modernization efforts and automation. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in backup and recovery technologies, enterprise storage platforms, infrastructure architecture, automation, and operational governance, along with the ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, cloud, security, application, and business stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Backup & Recovery Engineering Design, implement, and maintain enterprise backup and recovery architectures supporting critical business applications and infrastructure. Engineer scalable, resilient, and secure backup solutions across physical, virtual, cloud, SaaS, and containerized environments. Develop and maintain backup standards, recovery procedures, operational runbooks, and engineering documentation. Lead backup platform upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives. Establish and maintain recovery service levels, recovery objectives, and testing standards. Data Protection Platform Administration Administer And Engineer Enterprise Data Protection Platforms Including IBM Storage Protect (Spectrum Protect / TSM) IBM Storage Defender Data Protect Rubrik Security Cloud Commvault Cloud-native backup technologies Responsibilities Include Platform architecture Capacity planning Performance tuning Security hardening Lifecycle management Troubleshooting and escalation support Cyber Recovery & Ransomware Protection Design and implement cyber recovery strategies to improve organizational resilience in partnership with the DR team. Partner with Information Security teams to support ransomware preparedness initiatives. Evaluate and implement immutable storage, air-gapped recovery vaults, and cyber recovery technologies. Participate in cyber recovery exercises and validation testing. Identify and mitigate risks impacting recoverability and business continuity. Engineering & Architecture Provide technical leadership for backup, storage, and recovery architecture initiatives. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to existing platforms. Participate in enterprise architecture reviews and infrastructure design discussions. Define standards, patterns, and best practices for enterprise data protection services. Contribute to long-term strategic roadmaps for data protection and cyber resilience. Automation & Operational Excellence Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, Ansible, or similar tools. review_candidates.title: IT Administrator
review_candidates.description: Efficiency Addict: You know that little rush you get when you replace a 15-step manual process with one automated workflow? Or when you finally figure out why Salesforce isn't behaving? Or when you connect two systems that should have been talking to each other all along? If that feeling never gets old AND and you're looking for a place where you can make that kind of impact, then keep reading! AlgaeCal is on the hunt for an IT Administrator who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and keep our tech systems running smoothly. Small print here ⇒ We need someone with experience in IT management and a passion for problem-solving. So if you don’t love tech like Steve Jobs loved turtlenecks, you might want to stop here. Still here? Great… This job will give you ALL the feels: At AlgaeCal, we’re driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density. The good news? AlgaeCal has the world’s only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal. Here’s what you’ll be up to in this busy role: Slack, Jira & Confluence: You’ll build and support workflows and automations across the tools our teams use every day. If there’s a repetitive process that can be streamlined, you’ll probably be the person who figures out how. Google Workspace: You’ll own the day-to-day administration of Google Workspace. From user accounts and permissions to troubleshooting issues and keeping everything secure and running smoothly. Security & Compliance: You’ll help protect AlgaeCal by supporting security training, risk assessments, compliance controls, and internal and external audits across frameworks like SOC 2, PCI, and HIPAA. Hardware & Software: You’ll be the go-to person when technology decides not to cooperate. Computers, routers, A/V equipment, software, inventory—you’ll troubleshoot problems, keep everything organized, and make sure our team has the tools they need to get their work done. Salesforce: You’ll help keep our Salesforce ecosystem humming. Supporting requests from internal teams, troubleshooting and improving flows, and spotting opportunities to make the system cleaner, smarter, and easier to use. ERP Systems: You’ll play a hands-on role in implementing and improving our ERP system. That means helping design workflows, building automations, troubleshooting issues, and making sure the system actually makes people’s jobs easier. This job might be for you if you’ve got… A resume that proves you know your way around business systems: We want to see 1+ years of hands-on experience managing Salesforce or a similar CRM, plus workflows and automations across tools like Slack, Jira, or Confluence. A solid security and compliance foundation: SOC 2, PCI, HIPAA, risk assessments, controls, audits. You don’t need to know everything, but this language shouldn’t make your eyes glaze over. An encyclopedic knowledge of everyday tech: Computers, routers, A/V equipment, software. You’re comfortable troubleshooting the stuff that keeps an office running. ERP experience: You’ve helped implement, build, or support an ERP system and understand how to turn real business processes into workflows that actually work. Top-notch problem-solving skills: When Salesforce breaks, an automation goes rogue, or someone’s laptop decides Monday morning is a great time to quit, you’re the person people want in the room. Bonus points for certifications: Salesforce Administrator or another relevant IT certification will definitely get our attention. Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If you’re nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we can’t wait to meet you. Other Qualities You’ll Need At AlgaeCal we’re going to insist that you have these 3 qualities: You’re humble--you put the team and others’ needs ahead of your own You’re hungry to learn more You’re people smart--in the sense that you’re a great teammate The truth is, if you don’t have these qualities you won’t last long at AlgaeCal. So if you’re missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you. What Will You Earn? We believe in rewarding top talent. So let’s talk about salary once we’ve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, we’re generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, we’ll make sure the compensation reflects that. You’ll also enjoy the following benefits: A generous healthcare package Monthly team events and activities Flexible Stat Holidays with the option to bank days for later use Weekly team lunches Casual dress code Incredible dog friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain And above all, you’ll join a team that you’ll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many people’s lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too. How To Apply So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal? Job opportunities like this don’t come along often, and we’ve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future IT Administrator is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application: If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please, read carefully: 1. Write a cover letter addressing: Why are you the best IT Administrator for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements. Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here: What's the toughest challenge you’ve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it? What are the last three books you’ve read? What do you do for fun? 2. Explain what you’re doing now for a job: If you don’t have one, explain why. If you have one, explain why you’re looking elsewhere. 3. Upload your cover letter and resume: Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file. Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but it’s our way of selecting the best--and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops. Click the “Apply Now” button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume. ***Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read! We are looking to hire as soon as we find the right person, so act quickly and you can also expect a prompt response.

Develop, review, and maintain System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), security policies, procedures, and supporting documentation. Coordinate vulnerability remediation efforts with engineering and operations teams while tracking corrective actions to completion. Monitor enterprise security posture using cybersecurity tools, vulnerability scanners, endpoint protection platforms, and security monitoring solutions. Support security accreditation activities, audits, inspections, and compliance reporting. Evaluate proposed system changes to determine security impacts and recommend appropriate safeguards. Participate in incident response activities, forensic support, root cause analysis, and lessons learned documentation. Collaborate with system administrators, network engineers, cloud engineers, software developers, and Government stakeholders to integrate cybersecurity throughout system design and operations. Support implementation of Zero Trust principles, cloud security best practices, identity and access management, encryption, and secure configuration standards. Develop security metrics, dashboards, and reports to communicate cybersecurity performance and risk. Senior-level professionals may lead cybersecurity engineering efforts, oversee RMF activities, serve as Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), mentor junior staff, and advise Government leadership on enterprise cybersecurity strategy and compliance. Required Qualifications Qualifications vary based on position level. High School diploma with relevant experience or bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, risk management, security controls, and secure system design. Familiarity with vulnerability management, security monitoring, and cybersecurity best practices. Experience developing technical documentation and communicating cybersecurity risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to obtain and maintain any required Government security clearance. Desired Qualifications Experience supporting Federal Government or Department of State cybersecurity programs. Experience serving as an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) or Information System Security Manager (ISSM). Experience implementing the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) and supporting Authority to Operate (ATO) processes. Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, FISMA, FedRAMP, and other Federal cybersecurity standards. Experience with vulnerability management tools such as Tenable Nessus, Tenable Security Center, Qualys, or similar platforms. Experience using security information and event management (SIEM) tools such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk Enterprise Security, IBM QRadar, or Microsoft Defender XDR. Experience supporting endpoint security, identity and access management (IAM), multi-factor authentication (MFA), PKI, and privileged access management (PAM). CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. A focus on continuous growth. Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy. Apporter une expertise sur les standards de sécurité et les solutions de protection appliqués aux services cloud. Accompagner les architectes techniques et les responsables applicatifs pour concevoir la sécurité des services. Assurer le recueil et le cadrage des besoins avec les équipes techniques Évaluer les mesures de sécurité en place et faire des recommandations d'amélioration en concordance avec les niveaux de risques. review_candidates.description: Job Title: DPAE Aircraft Carriers Sr Cyber Security Architect Job Category: Engineering Time Type: Full time Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret Employee Type: Regular Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% Type of Travel: Continental US * * * The Opportunity The Contractor shall research, evaluate, and implement next-generation cyber capabilities across the DPAE CVN portfolio utilizing advanced data science and specialized engineering to ensure the rapid fielding of capabilities. Emerging Mandates Analysis: Perform technical analysis and research on emerging mandates, including Zero Trust for operational technology (OT), control systems, and combat systems, to transform cyber operations and mitigate cyber risks posed by Frontier AI and post-quantum cryptography. Technology Evaluation: Evaluate novel, emerging cybersecurity technologies and solutions to continuously improve the CVN cybersecurity posture. Conduct specialized research on emerging threats and vulnerabilities targeting Navy control systems, networks, and Hull, Mechanical, and Electrical (HM&E) assets. Collaborative RDT&E: Collaborate with academia, federally funded research and development centers (FFRDCs), and Naval Warfare Centers (e.g., NSWC, NUWC) to provide domain expertise on cyber engineering standards and design criteria, supporting DPAE CVN interoperability with defensive cyber operations capabilities and architectures. Market Research: Conduct market research for commercial and non-traditional technologies, prioritizing solutions that deliver overwhelming efficiencies and rapidly field capabilities into the maritime domain. The Contractor shall perform advanced cyber analytics and defensive operations to reduce technical stovepipes and improve the security posture of maritime critical infrastructure. Risk Metrics & Dashboards: Define, evolve, and manage key performance indicators (KPIs), key risk indicators (KRIs), and advanced metrics to provide DPAE CVN leadership with clear visibility into portfolio cyber risk postures. Develop advanced dashboards and analytical reports to inform strategic decisions and increase battlespace awareness. Data-Centric Analytics: Leverage data-centric cyber analytics and work directly with Digital Operations teams to stream continuous insights, streamline data processes, and recommend enabling technologies that harden system cybersecurity and operational readiness. Incident Response Planning & Support: Develop and coordinate cyber incident response processes that support integration with Commander's Critical Information Requirements (CCIR) and Maritime Cyber Planning and Response Centers. Incident Support: Participate as required in cybersecurity incident response efforts, including analyzing cyber events, investigating intrusions, and recommending containment, mitigation, and eradication measures in accordance with Navy incident response procedures. The Contractor shall facilitate technical integration across the maritime engineering ecosystem and foster a strong culture of cyber awareness. Multi-Agency Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Portfolio Acquisition Executives, Engineering Agents, Technical Warrant Holders (TWHs), Type Commanders (TYCOM), the Supervisor of Shipbuilding (SUPSHIP), shipbuilders, and cybersecurity enclave managers. Ensure that cybersecurity engineering is holistically integrated into all aspects of CVN design, construction, modernization, sustainment, and operations. Technical Communication: Translate complex cyber risks and technical engineering recommendations into clear, actionable briefs for both technical and non-technical audiences, emphasizing potential impacts on mission capabilities to leadership. Mentoring & Culture: Provide technical advisory support and mentoring to junior cybersecurity systems engineers. Qualifications Required: Education: Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical, Computer, or Systems Engineering from an accredited university. Experience: Minimum of 7 years of direct experience with machinery control systems, network security, and cybersecurity design, testing, and commissioning. Technical Writing: Demonstrated strong technical writing, documentation, and oral communication skills. Security Clearance: Active U.S. Secret Security Clearance (U.S. Citizenship required). Desired Professional Certifications: CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), or CCIE (Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert). Navy Domain Experience: Direct experience supporting Navy, Coast Guard, or Merchant Marine platforms, with highly preferred specialization in Aircraft Carriers (CVN 68 and CVN 78 classes). Maritime Infrastructure Experience: Experience working with or at a shipyard, Naval Warfare Center (NSWC/NUWC), Supervisor of Shipbuilding Command (SUPSHIP), Regional Maintenance Center (RMC), or Type Commander (TYCOM) supporting construction, operation, maintenance, modernization, and/or repair. Technical Authority: Proven experience collaborating with Technical Warrant Holders (TWHs) and naval systems engineering directorates. What You Can Expect A culture of integrity. At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation. An environment of trust. CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality. A focus on continuous growth. Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy. Pay Range There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits. The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is $113,200 - $237,800 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. review_candidates.title: Infrastructure & Operations Manager
review_candidates.description: If interested in this opportunity, please visit our website to read the full announcement. Applications closes on 09/10/2026. Hello, we’re Metro ! Metro is dedicated to shaping a better future for the greater Portland region. The work the people of Metro do every day benefits the lives of the people who live here, today, and tomorrow. The Information Technology department is looking for an Infrastructure & Operations Manager to lead the teams that run the technology foundation the rest of the organization relies on. Metro is responsible for regional planning, garbage and recycling, conserving natural areas, providing parks, and operating the Portland Expo Center, the Oregon Convention Center, and the Oregon Zoo. The infrastructure behind it works across the offices, venues, transfer stations, and parks. Providing Metro's variety of services with resilient and reliable technology is a point of pride for our team. Today Metro runs a hybrid environment: on-premises infrastructure alongside cloud services, hybrid identity, a Microsoft enterprise stack, and endpoints spanning all our locations. The environment is stable and well cared for, built and run by a team with deep knowledge of Metro's systems.  The future of infrastructure and operations is being reshaped by automation and AI, and Metro is investing in that future: in stronger service management, in automation that takes on routine work so people can focus their expertise where it matters most, and in AI-assisted ways of working. Every choice along the way gets weighed by whether it makes the work more reliable and the team more capable.  We're looking for a leader who can take us there. Someone who has strengthened an infrastructure team's practices and readiness for what's next, and who leads as a team player. Someone who takes Metro's goals as their own, partnering with the departments and venues we serve so their needs drive the work, all while keeping our essential technology services on and available. If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you. As the Infrastructure & Operations Manager you will Lead Metro's Systems and Support teams, 14 staff across systems administration and help desk, through two direct-report supervisors.  Keep Metro's systems dependable and secure, so the people of Metro can rely on technology to do their work. Your teams run on-call, and major incident escalation ends with you.  Strengthen the resilience and availability of Metro's systems, including backup and disaster recovery, so critical services hold up through disruption.  Mature Metro's IT service management, building the change, incident, and problem practices that make service measurable, responsive, and steadily improving.  Bring modern practices into everyday operations: infrastructure and configuration as code, observability that catches issues before users report them, and shared documentation that makes systems easier for the whole team to support.  Own the life cycle and architecture of Metro's systems: deciding whether to modernize, consolidate, migrate, or retire, and where each workload should run.  Lead the practical, responsible adoption of AI and other innovations in operations, and help your teams build the skills to harness this tool.  Partner with Metro's cybersecurity leadership to run infrastructure that meets Metro's information security needs.  Work across Metro's departments and venues, translating technology decisions into terms the people who rely on them can understand and trust.  Develop and manage the infrastructure and operations budget, set vendor and contracting strategy, and get strong value from Metro's technology investments.  Keep capacity ahead of demand: knowing what the team should own, what's better handled by vendors and partners, and how the mix should shift as needs change.  Own Metro's major infrastructure initiatives and capital investments: making the case for them, delivering what was promised, and being accountable for the value they return. Attributes for success You've led an infrastructure team through modernization, consolidations, or migrations, while the systems stayed up and the work of the organization carried on.  You have a strong foundation in enterprise systems, networking, storage, and identity, and you're credible with the system administrators who run them.  You know the Microsoft ecosystem deeply, on-premises and cloud, including licensing and endpoints, and you keep it evolving as the organization's needs change.  You've made a service operation measurably better, implementing service management practices that made a difference, and it stayed better after you moved on to the next thing.  You've led through real incidents: keeping your head while systems are down, running a blameless review after, and making fixes that mean the same failure doesn't repeat.  You find places to automate repetitive work in your team through scripts, pipelines, or configuration, and you can say what you automated first and why, because you'd rather find a better way than to keep doing it manually.  You scale process to risk: changes with real blast radius get real controls, and routine work doesn't get buried under them.  You give people ownership, clear what's in their way, and grow their skills, and it shows in your team: people who work well together and like the work.  You're a strong collaborator, with the teams you work beside and the people who depend on your services, and they bring you into problems early.  Your organizational skills let you keep daily operations, projects, budget, and vendors all moving, and your team still gets to the quiet yet crucial work like patching, backup testing, and lifecycle replacement.  You have demonstrated experience with IT vendor, service, and contract management to get the most value for IT services. TO QUALIFY We will consider any combination of relevant work experience, volunteering, education, and transferable skills as qualifying unless an item or section is labeled required. Please be clear and specific in your application materials on how your background is relevant.  Minimum qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, and Five (5) years of experience leading or supervising technical staff or teams in IT infrastructure or IT operations, and Two (2) years of experience managing IT infrastructure projects or initiatives, such as migrations, consolidations, upgrades, or system implementations, or Any combination of education, professional, volunteer and lived experience that provides the necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the classification duties and responsibilities. Hybrid Telework  This position is designated as “hybrid telework.” You will be required to work onsite and at times have the option to work away from your assigned work location. The specific schedule and balance of onsite and telework will be discussed with the hiring manager at the time of offer. Employees must reside in Oregon or Washington to work at Metro. Please note, the designation of hybrid telework may be subject to change at a future time. This position supports systems that operate outside business hours, including at Metro's venues. Travel between Metro locations, evening and weekend work, and extended hours may be required.  The teams this position leads provide on-call coverage. During major incidents and emergencies, this position may be required to report onsite on short notice. Like to have qualifications You do not need to have the following preferred qualifications/transferable skills to qualify. However, keep in mind we may consider them when identifying the most qualified candidates. Your transferable skills are any skills you have gained through education, work experience, including the military, or life experience that are relevant for this position. Training or certification in an IT service management framework or methodology, such as ITIL, COBIT, or an equivalent. Experience in government or another highly regulated industry, such as healthcare, utilities, or financial services. Experience leading or working within a union-represented workforce. Demonstrated use of AI tools in your own work, and experience bringing a team along in adopting them. COMPENSATION, BENEFITS AND REPRESENTATON The full-salary range for this position is step 1: $134,836.98 to step 6: $172,089.69. However, unless a candidate’s qualifications justify, based on the Oregon Pay Equity Act requirements and Metro’s internal equity review process, the appointment will likely be made between step 1: $134,836.98 to the equity range step 4: $156,091.17.  This position is not eligible for overtime and is non-represented. It is classified as a Manager II position. Classification descriptions are typically written broadly and do not include the specific duties and responsibilities of the positions. View the classification description. Questions? Recruiter: Carrie Gundermann Email: carrie.gundermann@oregonmetro.gov

review_candidates.title: Technical Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: STARLIMS provides leading Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) solutions that have served customers around the world for over 30 years. STARLIMS solution suite helps to improve the reliability of laboratory sampling processes, manage complex testing workflows and analytical methods, support compliance with global regulatory requirements and industry standards, and provide comprehensive reporting, monitoring, and analysis capabilities. With multiple support centers across the globe, STARLIMS solutions are used in labs across multiple industries and disciplines including pharma & biotech, life sciences, food & beverage, manufacturing, petrochemical refineries and oil & gas, chemical, public health, forensics and environmental offering an influx of global career opportunities. Purpose: The Technical Support Engineer delivers accurate and timely technical support, guidance, and solutions related to the organization’s products and services throughout the customer lifecycle. This role involves communicating with customers via email, phone, or support systems to address inquiries, understand technical challenges, assess needs, and recommend appropriate solutions or alternatives. The Support Engineer applies established procedures and, when necessary, develops new approaches to resolve technical issues. Responsibilities include managing support cases, ensuring effective follow-up, and maintaining clear communication to drive resolution and enhance customer satisfaction. Summary: Take full ownership of assigned support tickets, ensuring timely investigation, resolution, and communication throughout the lifecycle. Develop deep expertise in STARLIMS application configuration and functionality. Perform remote analysis, troubleshooting, and resolution of technical issues Monitor the number of incident tickets and manage the incidents: Investigation, additional tests, resolution and closure or escalation to Engineering after relevant qualification and follow-up. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve complex issues and improve support processes. Contribute to global support improvement initiatives and knowledge sharing. Recommend systems enhancements to reduce recurring user issues. Adhere to established procedures while proactively identifying opportunities for optimization. Maintain clear, professional communication with customers to ensure high levels of satisfaction. Show a global support mindset. Who You Are: Demonstrated written and verbal communication, interpersonal, facilitation, presentation, quantitative, analytical, organizational, and follow-up skills. Ability to establish/maintain good working relationships and be able to work cooperatively/productively with engineers, vendors, and customers is required. Strong ability to troubleshoot software problems - identify and solve problems creatively and effectively. Ability to learn and understand new processes, as well as recommend ways to continuously improve. Experience working in a broader enterprise/cross-division business unit model preferred Ability to work in a highly matrixed and geographically diverse business environment. Ability to work within a team and as an individual contributor in a fast paced, changing environment. Ability to leverage and/or engage others to accomplish projects. Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization. Multitasks, prioritizes, and meets deadlines in a timely manner. Strong organizational and follow-up skills, as well as attention to detail. Experience as a Programmer with SQL language as well as an object-oriented language (C# or equivalent). Experience with RDMS such as Oracle, SQL Server, MS-SQL, etc. Experience with reporting tools (Crystal Reports, Tableau) and with web technologies such as Web Services, API, HTML, CSS and JavaScript is desired. Based in Singapore, with a valid driving licence or ability to travel independently; willing and able to attend customer sites within Singapore and be onsite within the contractual SLA during business hours. Fluency in oral and written English. Ability to speak a local language in addition to English is a strong plus. Nice to have: Prior LIMS, ELN, SDMS or LES experience Candidates must currently hold valid Singapore work authorization (e.g., Singapore Citizen, Permanent Resident, or an eligible working pass) STARLIMS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, religion, color, national or ethnic origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, genetic information, veteran status, age or disability status.
