new_matches.title: Direct Indexing Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Dev Ops Engineer
new_matches.description: Vanguard Personalized Indexing (VPI) is a rapidly growing business within Financial Advisor Services. We enable financial advisors to deliver tax-efficient, customized direct indexing portfolios at scale. Our platform manages thousands of investor accounts and evaluates portfolios daily to support portfolio construction, optimization, tax-loss harvesting, trading, and investment research workflows. VPI operates at the intersection of investment management, cloud-native engineering, and advanced analytics. We are modernizing our technology platform through a multi-year transformation that includes AWS migration, cloud-native architecture adoption, platform scalability improvements, enhanced resiliency, and expansion of our investment technology capabilities. We are seeking an experienced Platform & Infrastructure , Dev Ops Engineer to enable the engineering and operational foundations that power the VPI platform. This individual will be responsible for the delivery of cloud infrastructure, platform operations, DevOps, security engineering enablement, and enterprise integration capabilities while serving as a key technical lead across the team. This role is responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating VPI's cloud platform and engineering infrastructure. The individual will partner closely with application, data, product, and architecture teams to enable highly reliable and scalable investment systems. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise across AWS, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, Kubernetes, DevOps practices, security enablement, and enterprise systems integration. This role combines hands-on technical execution with architectural leadership and operational ownership. Core Responsibilities Platform Engineering & Cloud Infrastructure Design, build, and operate cloud-native infrastructure supporting VPI's investment platform. Lead AWS platform architecture, modernization, and migration initiatives. Design scalable, highly available, and secure infrastructure patterns across development, test, and production environments. Manage Kubernetes and container platforms supporting distributed workloads. Drive infrastructure standardization, resiliency, disaster recovery, and capacity planning. Continuously improve platform observability, monitoring, logging, and operational readiness. DevOps & Automation Establish and evolve CI/CD pipelines and engineering automation practices. Drive Infrastructure-as-Code adoption using modern provisioning and configuration-management frameworks. Automate deployment, environment management, compliance validation, and operational processes. Improve engineering productivity through tooling, platform services, and self-service capabilities. Define and implement operational best practices for cloud-native application delivery. Security Engineering & Architecture Enablement Partner with Enterprise Security and application teams to design secure platform architectures. Enable implementation of security controls, vulnerability remediation, identity management, encryption, network segmentation, and cloud governance frameworks. Support regulatory, audit, risk, and compliance initiatives. Drive proactive remediation of security findings and operational risks. Establish secure-by-default platform patterns and guardrails. Enterprise & External System Integration Design and support integrations with Vanguard enterprise platforms and external vendors. Build secure and scalable connectivity patterns across cloud and on-premises environments. Enable data exchange, APIs, messaging, file transfer, and service integrations. Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate emerging technology solutions and integration opportunities. Innovation, Architecture & Proof of Concepts Lead technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and pilot initiatives supporting strategic platform evolution. Assess new technologies, cloud services, engineering tools, and architecture patterns. Collaborate with product, research, and engineering teams to accelerate innovation. Influence long-term platform architecture and modernization roadmaps. Operational Excellence Serve as a senior escalation point for complex production issues and platform incidents. Lead root cause analysis, remediation planning, and reliability improvements. Establish service-level objectives, operational metrics, and reliability standards. Reduce operational risk through automation, standardization, and improved engineering practices. Ensure platform services meet performance, availability, scalability, and recoverability objectives. Technical Leadership Provide architecture guidance and technical leadership across infrastructure and platform domains. Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence throughout the organization. Lead design reviews and infrastructure governance processes. Champion modern engineering practices and continuous improvement. Qualifications Required 10+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, or related fields. Deep expertise with AWS cloud services and cloud-native architectures. Strong experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms in production environments. Expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code and automation frameworks. Experience designing secure, highly available distributed systems. Strong Linux, networking, and systems engineering background. Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices. Experience supporting mission-critical production systems with high availability requirements. Strong understanding of information security, cloud security, and risk management principles. Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives across multiple teams. Excellent troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills. Preferred Experience within asset management, wealth management, trading, or investment platforms. Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar technologies. Experience supporting enterprise cloud migrations and large-scale modernization programs. Experience with observability platforms, monitoring solutions, and SRE practices. Familiarity with financial services regulatory and compliance requirements. Experience integrating cloud platforms with enterprise systems and third-party vendors. Special Factors Sponsorship Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position. About Vanguard At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission. To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best. How We Work Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

Concerts, sporting events, and festivals create memorable lifelong experiences with clients, prospects, partners, friends, and family—and they drive real business impact. Companies spend more than $600 billion each year on client entertainment. TicketManager is the enterprise platform they trust to source, manage, track, and report on live event tickets and hospitality—while maintaining compliance, control, and visibility across the organization. Built at the intersection of live events, technology, and enterprise operations, TicketManager makes client entertainment easy and measurable. Our industry-leading software supports everything from invitations and event execution to post-event reporting, helping companies clearly prove ROI and strengthen relationships through unforgettable experiences. TicketManager is trusted by thousands of global brands, including Anheuser-Busch, Verizon, American Express, Nike, and Visa, as well as Fortune 500 companies, professional sports leagues, and major organizations such as the NBA, NFL, NCAA, and NASCAR. We’re also proud to partner with some of the most iconic teams and venues in sports and entertainment, including the New York Jets, Philadelphia Eagles and Phillies, Capital One Arena, Texas Rangers, LAFC, and Seattle Seahawks, along with more than 50 professional and collegiate teams, franchises, universities, and technology providers. Why Work at TicketManager At TicketManager, you’ll help build technology that brings people together through live experiences—while solving complex, real-world problems for the world’s best companies. We’re a fast-growing, profitable company that values ownership, collaboration, and excellence, and we’re building a team that’s passionate about making work impactful and fun. If you’re excited about live events, cutting-edge technology, and doing work that truly matters, you’ll feel right at home here. The Role As our IT and Desktop Support Specialist, you'll be a key member of our Technology team, keeping the people, devices, and everyday tools that our company runs on working smoothly. One day you're setting up a new hire's laptop, the next you're resolving a WiFi issue in a conference room, resetting an MFA prompt, or helping a teammate get access to the software they need. You'll be the friendly, reliable face of IT day to day, with plenty of room to grow your skills and take on more responsibility over time. Responsibilities: Provide day-to-day technical support to team members across our offices and remote staff, resolving hardware, software, network and application issues Install, upgrade, and troubleshoot hardware and software systems including office networks, laptops, WiFi and conference room technology, and manage the device lifecycle from procurement through MDM enrollment, repair and retirement Provide on-boarding for new employees, and off-boarding for departing employees or internal changes in roles, including complete and timely access revocation Administer Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra, including accounts, licensing, groups, multi-factor authentication, conditional access, and mail routing and security Administer our SaaS platforms, with Rippling and Drata central and growing, alongside 1Password, GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Zendesk and Slack. Expect these platforms to take on more of the device, account and onboarding lifecycle over time, and to own how that gets built out Provision and maintain the customer-facing infrastructure our platform depends on, including e-ticket email accounts, phone numbers, distribution lists and per-customer email branding Maintain and troubleshoot the one-time-passcode forwarding path customers use to authenticate to third-party ticketing platforms Manage DNS, domains and certificates across our company domains, and support our cloud environment alongside the Technology team Run quarterly user access reviews and keep our compliance evidence in order Build integrations and automation between our platforms to reduce repetitive manual work Document procedures for procedure that other may need to perform Desired Skills and Experience: Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field 1–3 years of experience in an IT help desk, desktop support, or technical support role Strong Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra administration experience. new_matches.title: Infrastructure & Operations Manager
new_matches.description: If interested in this opportunity, please visit our website to read the full announcement. Applications closes on 09/10/2026. Hello, we’re Metro ! Metro is dedicated to shaping a better future for the greater Portland region. The work the people of Metro do every day benefits the lives of the people who live here, today, and tomorrow. The Information Technology department is looking for an Infrastructure & Operations Manager to lead the teams that run the technology foundation the rest of the organization relies on. Metro is responsible for regional planning, garbage and recycling, conserving natural areas, providing parks, and operating the Portland Expo Center, the Oregon Convention Center, and the Oregon Zoo. The infrastructure behind it works across the offices, venues, transfer stations, and parks. Providing Metro's variety of services with resilient and reliable technology is a point of pride for our team. Today Metro runs a hybrid environment: on-premises infrastructure alongside cloud services, hybrid identity, a Microsoft enterprise stack, and endpoints spanning all our locations. The environment is stable and well cared for, built and run by a team with deep knowledge of Metro's systems.  The future of infrastructure and operations is being reshaped by automation and AI, and Metro is investing in that future: in stronger service management, in automation that takes on routine work so people can focus their expertise where it matters most, and in AI-assisted ways of working. Every choice along the way gets weighed by whether it makes the work more reliable and the team more capable.  We're looking for a leader who can take us there. Someone who has strengthened an infrastructure team's practices and readiness for what's next, and who leads as a team player. Someone who takes Metro's goals as their own, partnering with the departments and venues we serve so their needs drive the work, all while keeping our essential technology services on and available. If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you. As the Infrastructure & Operations Manager you will Lead Metro's Systems and Support teams, 14 staff across systems administration and help desk, through two direct-report supervisors.  Keep Metro's systems dependable and secure, so the people of Metro can rely on technology to do their work. Your teams run on-call, and major incident escalation ends with you.  Strengthen the resilience and availability of Metro's systems, including backup and disaster recovery, so critical services hold up through disruption.  Mature Metro's IT service management, building the change, incident, and problem practices that make service measurable, responsive, and steadily improving.  Bring modern practices into everyday operations: infrastructure and configuration as code, observability that catches issues before users report them, and shared documentation that makes systems easier for the whole team to support.  Own the life cycle and architecture of Metro's systems: deciding whether to modernize, consolidate, migrate, or retire, and where each workload should run.  Lead the practical, responsible adoption of AI and other innovations in operations, and help your teams build the skills to harness this tool.  Partner with Metro's cybersecurity leadership to run infrastructure that meets Metro's information security needs.  Work across Metro's departments and venues, translating technology decisions into terms the people who rely on them can understand and trust.  Develop and manage the infrastructure and operations budget, set vendor and contracting strategy, and get strong value from Metro's technology investments.  Keep capacity ahead of demand: knowing what the team should own, what's better handled by vendors and partners, and how the mix should shift as needs change.  Own Metro's major infrastructure initiatives and capital investments: making the case for them, delivering what was promised, and being accountable for the value they return. Attributes for success You've led an infrastructure team through modernization, consolidations, or migrations, while the systems stayed up and the work of the organization carried on.  You have a strong foundation in enterprise systems, networking, storage, and identity, and you're credible with the system administrators who run them.  You know the Microsoft ecosystem deeply, on-premises and cloud, including licensing and endpoints, and you keep it evolving as the organization's needs change.  You've made a service operation measurably better, implementing service management practices that made a difference, and it stayed better after you moved on to the next thing.  You've led through real incidents: keeping your head while systems are down, running a blameless review after, and making fixes that mean the same failure doesn't repeat.  You find places to automate repetitive work in your team through scripts, pipelines, or configuration, and you can say what you automated first and why, because you'd rather find a better way than to keep doing it manually.  You scale process to risk: changes with real blast radius get real controls, and routine work doesn't get buried under them.  You give people ownership, clear what's in their way, and grow their skills, and it shows in your team: people who work well together and like the work.  You're a strong collaborator, with the teams you work beside and the people who depend on your services, and they bring you into problems early.  Your organizational skills let you keep daily operations, projects, budget, and vendors all moving, and your team still gets to the quiet yet crucial work like patching, backup testing, and lifecycle replacement.  You have demonstrated experience with IT vendor, service, and contract management to get the most value for IT services. TO QUALIFY We will consider any combination of relevant work experience, volunteering, education, and transferable skills as qualifying unless an item or section is labeled required. Please be clear and specific in your application materials on how your background is relevant.  Minimum qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, and Five (5) years of experience leading or supervising technical staff or teams in IT infrastructure or IT operations, and Two (2) years of experience managing IT infrastructure projects or initiatives, such as migrations, consolidations, upgrades, or system implementations, or Any combination of education, professional, volunteer and lived experience that provides the necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the classification duties and responsibilities. Hybrid Telework  This position is designated as “hybrid telework.” You will be required to work onsite and at times have the option to work away from your assigned work location. The specific schedule and balance of onsite and telework will be discussed with the hiring manager at the time of offer. Employees must reside in Oregon or Washington to work at Metro. Please note, the designation of hybrid telework may be subject to change at a future time. This position supports systems that operate outside business hours, including at Metro's venues. Travel between Metro locations, evening and weekend work, and extended hours may be required.  The teams this position leads provide on-call coverage. During major incidents and emergencies, this position may be required to report onsite on short notice. Like to have qualifications You do not need to have the following preferred qualifications/transferable skills to qualify. However, keep in mind we may consider them when identifying the most qualified candidates. Your transferable skills are any skills you have gained through education, work experience, including the military, or life experience that are relevant for this position. Training or certification in an IT service management framework or methodology, such as ITIL, COBIT, or an equivalent. Experience in government or another highly regulated industry, such as healthcare, utilities, or financial services. Experience leading or working within a union-represented workforce. Demonstrated use of AI tools in your own work, and experience bringing a team along in adopting them. COMPENSATION, BENEFITS AND REPRESENTATON The full-salary range for this position is step 1: $134,836.98 to step 6: $172,089.69. However, unless a candidate’s qualifications justify, based on the Oregon Pay Equity Act requirements and Metro’s internal equity review process, the appointment will likely be made between step 1: $134,836.98 to the equity range step 4: $156,091.17.  This position is not eligible for overtime and is non-represented. It is classified as a Manager II position. Det handler om å bygge sikre, skalerbare og robuste plattformer som gjør det enklere å utvikle, modernisere og drifte digitale tjenester. Riktig bruk av sky gir bedre flyt, høyere kvalitet og mer verdi, både for virksomheten og brukerne. I Sopra Steria ser vi etter flere teknologer som vil være med å bygge, automatisere og videreutvikle moderne skyløsninger for noen av Norges mest spennende virksomheter. Hos oss blir du en del av Digital Platform Services, et fagmiljø som jobber tett med cloud, plattform, sikkerhet, automasjon, drift og arkitektur. Kanskje trives du best med infrastruktur som kode, moderne plattformtjenester, nettverk, sikkerhet eller DevOps-praksiser. Kanskje har du erfaring fra drift og forvaltning, og ønsker å jobbe mer med automatisering og sky. Eller kanskje jobber du allerede som Cloud Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps engineer eller teknisk arkitekt. Det viktigste for oss er at du liker å jobbe teknisk med sky, er nysgjerrig på ny teknologi og ønsker å bidra til løsninger som faktisk skaper verdi for kundene. Hva kan du jobbe med hos oss? Som skyteknolog i Sopra Steria jobber du med å bygge, videreutvikle og forvalte moderne sky- og plattformløsninger – fra arkitektur og automasjon til drift og kontinuerlig forbedring. Cloud- og plattformløsninger i Azure, AWS, Google Cloud og hybride miljøer infrastruktur som kode, automasjon og selvbetjente plattformer sikkerhet, nettverk, identitet, governance og landingssoner Kubernetes, containere, drift, overvåking og teknisk rådgivning Du trenger ikke kunne alt. Det viktigste er hva du kan i dag, hva du vil lære, og hvordan du ønsker å utvikle deg videre hos oss. Hvem ser vi etter? Vi ser etter deg som har teknisk erfaring og interesse for Cloud, infrastruktur, plattform eller moderne drift. Du kan for eksempel ha bakgrunn som Cloud Engineer, plattformingeniør, DevOps Engineer, infrastrukturspesialist, teknisk konsulent eller arkitekt. Du har gjerne erfaring med én eller flere skyplattformer som Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud. Din bakgrunn er gjerne fra infrastruktur, drift, plattform, nettverk eller sikkerhet. Du har interesse for automasjon, scripting, CI/CD og verktøy som Terraform, Bicep eller lignende. Erfaringen din innebærer gjerne Kubernetes, containere eller moderne plattformtjenester, og du har en forståelse for sikkerhet, robuste løsninger og samspillet mellom teknologi og forretning. I tillegg har du lyst til å dele kunnskap og bidra i et stort fagmiljø. With Metronome, companies can launch products faster, offer any pricing model, and streamline finance workflows without writing code. Our platform computes millions of invoices per billing period and is scaling rapidly to accommodate new customers, saving them hours of development time and manual invoicing and enabling them to use consumption data to better serve their customers. Our customers love our product and approach, and we’re humbled to work with amazing companies like OpenAI, NVIDIA, Confluent, and Anthropic. Your primary responsibilities will include handling customer escalations through our ticketing system, using internal observability tools to diagnose and scope customer-facing issues, collaborating directly with customers via Slack and other channels, and developing internal tools and documentation to improve the support experience. Since we view every support escalation as an opportunity to learn, both as individuals and as a company, you will play a critical role in providing feedback to our product team on common challenges and influencing our product roadmap. Through your interactions with individual customers, you will help improve our product for everyone. Develop internal tools to automate customer workflows that are currently unavailable in our product. Provide feedback on recurring patterns and advocate for addressing feature gaps in the product. Design and assist in implementing a comprehensive knowledge base to assist customers with using our product. Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum Requirements 2+ years of work experience in a B2B customer-facing technical support organization or in engineering Experience working closely with engineering teams and providing technical feedback on customer issues Ability to debug and triage bugs and escalations from customers Can communicate technical capabilities of the product to customers Experience writing scripts or internal tools using APIs, and functional knowledge of SQL Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to break down complex technical concepts clearly A mindset of customer empathy and ability to solve challenging problems Preferred Qualifications Experience as an early or founding member of a support team, including building processes from scratch Startup experience and familiarity with scaling a support team Programming experience in one or more of Typescript, Python, or Ruby You have worked on modern enterprise software which is business critical Experience creating knowledge base articles and internal documentation Familiarity with at least one ticketing system, such as Pylon, Zendesk, Front, or similar In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €76,800 - €115,200. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.
